facts.text: Based on Mark Schultz's comic Xenozoic Tales. Capcom released it in April 1993, the year the Cadillacs and Dinosaurs cartoon aired.
It's the 26th century. Dinosaurs are back, and poachers called the Black Marketeers are hunting them.
Four heroes: Jack (balanced), Hannah (skill), Mustapha (speed) and Mess (power).
In much of Asia it's simply known as "Mustapha's game", after its most popular hero.
It runs on CP System Dash, Capcom's board with QSound audio. That's why MAME needs qsound_hle.zip.
Dinosaurs attack everyone, heroes and gangs alike. Lure them into the crowd.
Attack + Jump together hits all around you but costs a little health. Save it for when you're surrounded.
Lose, and a gangster aims at you: "Eat lead, baby!" You get 20 seconds to continue. Luckily, coins are free here.
It has never appeared on a Capcom collection; licensing for the comic is the usual explanation.
